audit_scope: Maintained source, configuration, tests, documentation, a freshly packaged candidate, and bounded observation of the running installed candidate. Audit only; no rebrand implementation.

rows.source_location_or_runtime_surface: Package/module/target names, source symbols and paths, UI/window/menu titles, tests, scripts, docs, binary strings, packaged filenames
rows.provenance: Reference product name plus candidate clone qualifier; not an approved final identity
rows.owner_decision: Approve a trademark-cleared product name and canonical capitalization before implementation.
rows.verification_method: Case-insensitive static and packaged-binary search for keylume, excluding frozen evidence explicitly retained by policy

rows.source_location_or_runtime_surface: CFBundleIdentifier/URL name, Git remote and repository URL
rows.provenance: Candidate/operator namespace; ownership and intended public brand were not established by this audit
rows.owner_decision: Confirm the owning legal entity, reverse-DNS namespace, GitHub organization, and whether SERP is customer-facing.
rows.verification_method: Inspect plist, signing metadata, Git remote, and release configuration for only approved owner identifiers
